blocks.text:
After breakfast, set out on a private tour to Corcovado.

Transfer to the foot of the mountain, then take a special train through Tijuca rainforest.

Along the way, you may see lush vegetation and wildlife such as toucans, monkeys and armadillos.

At the summit of Corcovado, at an altitude of approximately 700 m, stands the 38 m statue of Christ the Redeemer.

The viewing platform offers a panorama of Rio.

You can see Guanabara Bay, Maracanã Stadium, Sugar Loaf, Copacabana and Ipanema beaches and Gávea Mountain.

After the tour, transfer back to the hotel.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, set out on a private tour to Sugar Loaf.

The cable car first takes you up Urca Hill.

This is the intermediate stop before the main summit. Here you can have a cocktail or try Brazilian dishes.

The next section of the cable car takes you to Sugar Loaf.

The summit offers views of Rio and the Atlantic coast.

On one side lies Copacabana, with Dois Irmãos and Gávea mountains beyond.

Below is Vermelha Beach.

On the other side, you can see Guanabara Bay, Botafogo, the city centre and the silhouette of Christ the Redeemer on Corcovado.

Return to the hotel after the tour.
